repositories.descriptionZh: 一款基于 Java、Spring Boot、Spring AI、RAG、向量搜索和大型语言模型（LLMs）构建的、具备生产级能力的 AI 驱动客户支持助手。提供智能工单分析、知识库问答、AI 生成的回复建议、工具调用、来源引用以及人工介入审批功能。

repositories.description: production-oriented RAG customer-support platform built with FastAPI, PostgreSQL/pgvector, OpenAI, and a lightweight vanilla HTML/CSS/JavaScript frontend. Fully containerized with Docker, with customer, support, and administrator workflows, RBAC, knowledge-base management, escalation, citations, analytics, logging, and automated testing.
repositories.descriptionZh: 一个基于 FastAPI、PostgreSQL/pgvector、OpenAI 以及轻量级的原生 HTML/CSS/JavaScript 前端构建的、面向生产环境的 RAG 客户支持平台。 该平台完全基于 Docker 容器化，包含客户、支持和管理员工作流，支持基于角色的访问控制（RBAC）、知识库管理、问题升级、引用、分析、日志记录和自动化测试。

repositories.description: AI-powered customer support email automation built with n8n, Gmail, Google Sheets, and Google Gemini. Automatically retrieves conversation history, uses a knowledge base to generate accurate responses, and replies to customers in the same email thread.
repositories.descriptionZh: 基于 n8n、Gmail、Google 表格和 Google Gemini 构建的、由人工智能驱动的客户支持邮件自动化系统。该系统可自动检索对话记录，利用知识库生成准确的回复，并在同一邮件线程中回复客户。

repositories.description: An AI-powered customer support platform that uses Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) to answer customer questions based on a company's internal knowledge base, including product documentation, FAQs, and policies.
repositories.descriptionZh: 一款基于人工智能的客户支持平台，该平台利用检索增强生成（RAG）技术，根据公司的内部知识库（包括产品文档、常见问题解答和政策）来回答客户的问题。

repositories.description: ResolveIQ is a GenAI-powered Customer Support Resolution Assistant for broadband and mobile telecom support agents. It uses customer data, conversation history, and a knowledge base to generate evidence-grounded responses with citations, while detecting missing information and escalating complex or unsupported issues to human agents.
repositories.descriptionZh: ResolveIQ 是一款基于生成式人工智能（GenAI）的客户支持解决助手，专为宽带和移动通信客服人员设计。它利用客户数据、对话记录和知识库，生成附有引用来源的、基于证据的回复，同时能够检测信息缺失，并将复杂或无法解决的问题上报给人工客服。

repositories.description: Python-based conversational AI assistant using the OpenAI API for automated customer support and question answering.
delfin is the SODA Infrastructure Manager project which provides unified, intelligent and scalable resource management, alert and performance monitoring
repositories.descriptionZh: delfin 是 SODA 基础设施管理器项目，提供统一、智能且可扩展的资源管理、告警和性能监控功能

repositories.description: VPS Pilot is a server monitoring and management platform designed for private VPS servers. It provides real-time monitoring, alerting, project management, and (future) cron job automation — all from a single dashboard.
repositories.descriptionZh: VPS Pilot 是一款专为私有 VPS 服务器设计的服务器监控与管理平台。它提供实时监控、警报、项目管理以及（未来将推出的）cron 任务自动化功能——所有功能均通过单一控制面板实现。

repositories.description: 🐝 Commercial IoT SaaS platform for real-time beehive monitoring, analytics, alerts, and farm management.
repositories.descriptionZh: 🐝 面向商业领域的物联网（IoT）SaaS平台，提供蜂箱实时监测、数据分析、警报及养蜂场管理功能。

repositories.description: An AI-based system that detects and classifies plant leaf diseases from images using deep learning. It helps identify diseases at an early stage and supports timely crop management. The project can also include weather monitoring, multilingual support, and SMS/email alerts to provide useful and accessible information to farmers.
repositories.descriptionZh: 这是一个基于人工智能的系统，利用深度学习技术通过图像检测和分类植物叶部病害。它有助于在早期阶段识别病害，并支持及时的作物管理。该项目还可包含天气监测、多语言支持以及短信/电子邮件提醒功能，为农民提供实用且易于获取的信息。

repositories.description: PROJECT 2: System Monitoring and Log Management - htop, disk usage, logrotate, syslog analysis, Cron alerts
repositories.descriptionZh: 项目 2：系统监控与日志管理——htop、磁盘使用情况、logrotate、syslog 分析、Cron 警报

repositories.description: MySQL relational database project for inventory management, stock monitoring, reorder alerts, suppliers, and purchase orders.
repositories.descriptionZh: 一个基于MySQL的关系型数据库项目，用于库存管理、库存监控、补货提醒、供应商管理和采购订单管理。

repositories.description: Arduino-based water level monitoring and management system using an ultrasonic sensor, relay-controlled pump, LCD display, and buzzer alerts to prevent water overflow and automate tank filling
repositories.descriptionZh: 基于Arduino的水位监测与管理系统，采用超声波传感器、继电器控制的水泵、LCD显示屏和蜂鸣器警报，以防止溢水并实现水箱自动注水

repositories.description: Child Safety Monitoring System using Vision and Sensor Integration for real-time child monitoring, GPS location tracking, and emergency alert management.
repositories.descriptionZh: 一款基于视觉与传感器融合技术的儿童安全监控系统，可实现儿童实时监控、GPS定位追踪及紧急警报管理。

repositories.description: A console-based C# Fleet Management System simulating vehicle operations, monitoring, dispatching, alerts, and real-time background processes using OOP, events, delegates, exceptions, and multithreading.
repositories.descriptionZh: 一个基于控制台的 C# 车队管理系统，利用面向对象编程（OOP）、事件、委托、异常和多线程技术，模拟车辆运行、监控、调度、警报以及实时后台进程。

repositories.description: The project is designed to detect potential forest fires at an early stage using sensor data and intelligent prediction techniques. It aims to improve environmental safety by enabling faster detection and timely alerts for fire prevention and monitoring.
repositories.descriptionZh: 该项目旨在利用传感器数据和智能预测技术，在早期阶段检测潜在的森林火灾。其目标是通过实现更快速的检测和及时预警，从而提升环境安全，做好火灾预防和监测工作。

repositories.description: This IoT-based flood monitoring system uses ESP32 with water-level, rain, and flow sensors to continuously monitor flood conditions. It classifies conditions as normal, warning, or danger and provides LED and buzzer alerts. Wi-Fi enables real-time monitoring through a web dashboard, supporting early warnings and safer flood management.
repositories.descriptionZh: 该基于物联网的洪水监测系统采用ESP32芯片，配合水位、降雨和流量传感器，对洪水状况进行持续监测。系统将状况分为“正常”、“预警”和“危险”三类，并通过LED指示灯和蜂鸣器发出警报。借助Wi-Fi功能，用户可通过网页控制面板进行实时监测，从而实现早期预警和更安全的洪水管理。

repositories.description: A Python/Flask-based SOC monitoring & threat detection platform with rule-based + ML anomaly detection, real-time dashboard, alert/incident management, and RBAC — built as a B.Tech cybersecurity project.
repositories.descriptionZh: 一个基于 Python/Flask 的 SOC 监控与威胁检测平台，具备基于规则和机器学习的异常检测、实时仪表盘、警报/事件管理以及基于角色的访问控制（RBAC）功能——作为网络安全专业（B.Tech）的毕业设计项目开发而成。

repositories.description: Developed a modular intrusion-detection system in Standard ML as part of a university dissertation, implementing anomaly detection, event monitoring, hashing, policy rules, state persistence and alert management.
repositories.descriptionZh: 作为大学毕业论文的一部分，使用Standard ML开发了一个模块化入侵检测系统，实现了异常检测、事件监控、哈希算法、策略规则、状态持久化及告警管理。

repositories.description: An IoT-Based Disaster Management System designed to detect and monitor emergency situations in real time using sensors and IoT technology. The system identifies hazards such as fire, smoke, gas leakage, and abnormal temperature, then sends alerts to enable faster response, improve safety, and reduce damage to people and property.
repositories.descriptionZh: 这是一个基于物联网（IoT）的灾害管理系统，旨在利用传感器和物联网技术实时检测和监测紧急情况。该系统可识别火灾、烟雾、气体泄漏和温度异常等危险，随后发送警报，从而加快响应速度、提高安全性，并减少对人员和财产的损害。

repositories.description: Orbital Eye is an Earth and Space Intelligence Platform that combines real-time aircraft, satellite, and earthquake data into one interactive map. It helps users monitor global events, understand situations quickly, and receive intelligence alerts r disaster management, emergency response, research, environmental monitoring, and aviation awareness.
repositories.descriptionZh: Orbital Eye 是一个地球与太空情报平台，它将实时飞机、卫星和地震数据整合到一张交互式地图中。该平台可帮助用户监测全球事件、快速掌握局势，并接收情报警报，广泛应用于灾害管理、应急响应、科研、环境监测及航空态势感知等领域。

repositories.description: Smart Water Tank Management System using LPC2129 ARM7. Monitors water level, temperature, and distance with automatic/manual pump control, servo valve, LCD, UART, RTC, EEPROM, CAN communication, buzzer alerts.
repositories.descriptionZh: 基于LPC2129 ARM7的智能水箱管理系统。可监测水位、温度和距离，并具备自动/手动水泵控制、伺服阀、LCD显示屏、UART、RTC、EEPROM、CAN通信及蜂鸣器警报功能。

repositories.description: The fastest way to automate a multi-tool business process in an afternoon. No setup fees. No learning curve. Connects to 400+ apps via n8n's built-in integrations — no custom code needed. Import the JSON, set your credentials, click activate. Running in minutes. ## What's Included - Project Management Competitor Monitoring And Alert — fully conf
repositories.descriptionZh: 在短短一个下午内实现多工具业务流程自动化的最快方式。 无需设置费。无需学习成本。通过 n8n 的内置集成连接 400 多个应用程序——无需编写自定义代码。导入 JSON 文件，设置凭据，点击激活。几分钟内即可运行。## 包含内容 - 项目管理、竞争对手监控与警报 — 完全配置

repositories.description: A production-style Azure operations environment covering governance, monitoring, alerting, and security posture management. This project moves past deploying resources and into actually running them, watching them, and keeping them compliant the way a real cloud team would.
repositories.descriptionZh: 一个涵盖治理、监控、告警和安全态势管理的生产级 Azure 运维环境。该项目不仅限于部署资源，更致力于像真正的云运维团队那样，实际运行、监控这些资源，并确保其符合合规要求。

repositories.description: StockFlow is an Inventory Management Dashboard designed to help administrators to manage products, track stock levels, and monitor inventory efficiently. It includes features such as product search and filtering, add/edit/delete operations, stock alerts, and dashboard summaries.
repositories.descriptionZh: StockFlow 是一款库存管理仪表盘，旨在帮助管理员高效管理产品、跟踪库存水平并监控库存。它包含产品搜索和筛选、添加/编辑/删除操作、库存警报以及仪表盘摘要等功能。

repositories.description: A collection of Security Operations Center (SOC) projects demonstrating practical experience in security monitoring, SIEM implementation, alert investigation, log analysis, detection engineering, dashboard creation, threat intelligence integration, and security event management using tools such as Wazuh and Sysmon.
repositories.descriptionZh: 一系列安全运营中心（SOC）项目，展示了在安全监控、SIEM实施、警报调查、日志分析、检测工程、仪表盘创建、威胁情报集成以及安全事件管理方面的实践经验，其中使用了Wazuh和Sysmon等工具。

repositories.description: This project is an Automated Security Incident Response & Management System (ASIR) designed to monitor, detect, and manage cybersecurity incidents. It provides a dashboard with real-time incident alerts, severity tracking, automated response actions, incident details, reports, and security monitoring.
repositories.descriptionZh: 该项目是一个自动化安全事件响应与管理系统（ASIR），旨在监控、检测和管理网络安全事件。它提供了一个仪表盘，包含实时事件警报、严重程度跟踪、自动化响应措施、事件详情、报告以及安全监控功能。

repositories.description: A cloud-based multi-tier application built on Microsoft Azure, with separate web, application, and database layers. The project focuses on secure networking, load balancing, automated monitoring, alerts, and efficient management of cloud resources.
repositories.descriptionZh: 这是一个基于 Microsoft Azure 构建的云端多层应用程序，包含独立的 Web 层、应用层和数据库层。该项目侧重于安全网络、负载均衡、自动化监控、警报以及云资源的高效管理。

repositories.description: LimeRadar XTR is a next-generation Telegram radar and raid management bot built for Web3 communities. 🚀 It connects Telegram with X monitoring to provide real-time token/project alerts, raid management, XP & leaderboards, multiple raid controls, admin tools, and customizable notifications.

The **Smart Agriculture System** is a Python-based project designed to manage farm operations by monitoring soil moisture, temperature, humidity, water level, and crop health. It analyzes farm conditions, determines irrigation requirements, generates alerts, and stores agricultural data for efficient farm management.
repositories.descriptionZh: **智能农业系统**是一个基于Python的项目，旨在通过监测土壤湿度、温度、空气湿度、水位和作物健康状况来管理农场运营。该系统可分析农场状况、确定灌溉需求、生成警报，并存储农业数据，从而实现高效的农场管理。

repositories.description: The **Healthy Battery Management System** is a Python-based project designed to monitor and analyze the health of a mobile device battery. It tracks voltage, current, temperature, charge level, and battery cycles to calculate battery health, predict future condition, and generate alerts.
repositories.descriptionZh: **健康电池管理系统**是一个基于 Python 的项目，旨在监测和分析移动设备电池的健康状况。它通过追踪电压、电流、温度、电量水平和电池循环次数，来计算电池健康状况、预测未来状态并生成警报。
